2024-07-19.title: Starting to write again.
2024-07-19.content:
I love the idea of a garden for thoughts.
Somehow, a shareable, wiki-like approach to writing has appealed to me.  As a great fan of Confluence, Notion, and technical notekeeping in general, this seems like an apt experiment for me to take on.

index.title: Hello!
index.content:
Thank you for stopping by my thought garden.
I’m Jen Bauer: tech educator, software whisperer, and community leader.
I started this thought garden as a space for sharing my thoughts on good software, quality assurance, and unknown other topics that fascinate me.
I am available for remote consulting through my business, Another Angle Solutions.
I am a process clarifier, documentation wizard, and SQL query conjurer, among many other helpful roles.
You are welcome to email me if you could use my expertise on your project.


You may also know me as a saxophonist or a sound designer.  Hey! Listen!
I published a white paper on interactive sound design.  Read all about it.
I’ve made games from time to time.  Click click!
You might enjoy my reviews on LinkedIn.  Whoa!
